title: Tooltip
description: A tooltip component with configurable positioning, arrow, shadow, truncation, and portal support.

children.description: React.ReactNode — The trigger element that the tooltip is attached to.

content.description: React.ReactNode — Content displayed inside the tooltip.

side.description: Preferred side of the trigger to display the tooltip.

align.description: Alignment of the tooltip along the side.

sideOffset.description: Distance in pixels from the trigger along the side axis.

alignOffset.description: Offset in pixels along the alignment axis.

maxWidth.description: Maximum width of the tooltip content.

wordWrap.description: Word wrap behavior for tooltip content.

delayDuration.description: Delay in milliseconds before showing the tooltip.

hideDelayDuration.description: Delay in milliseconds before hiding the tooltip.

hoverableContent.description: Keeps the tooltip open while the pointer moves onto it (WCAG 1.4.13). `false` closes it as soon as the pointer leaves the trigger.

onOpenChange.description: (open: boolean) => void — Callback when the open state changes.

showArrow.description: Whether to show the tooltip arrow.

arrowSize.description: Size of the tooltip arrow in pixels.

truncate.description: Whether to truncate the trigger content with ellipsis.

truncateWidth.description: Width at which to truncate the trigger content.

shadow.description: Shadow preset or custom CSS shadow value. Presets: 'none', 'sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl', '2xl'.

portal.description: Whether to render the tooltip in a portal.

portalContainer.description: HTMLElement | null — Custom container element for the tooltip portal. Read only when `portal` is true; with `portal={false}` it chooses nothing.

asChild.description: When true, the trigger renders as the child element instead of wrapping it.

triggerDisplay.description: CSS display property for the trigger wrapper.

className.description: CSS class for the trigger wrapper element.

style.description: Inline styles for the trigger wrapper element, with `className`.

id.description: Id of the element that takes focus: the child it wraps, or the wrapper around plain text. Wins over the child's own.

aria-label.description: Accessible name of the element that takes focus: the child it wraps, or the wrapper around plain text. Wins over the child's own.

aria-labelledby.description: Ids of the elements that name the element that takes focus: the child it wraps, or the wrapper around plain text. Wins over the child's own.

aria-describedby.description: Ids of the elements that describe the element that takes focus: the child it wraps, or the wrapper around plain text; joined after the child's own and before the tooltip's id while it is open.

unstyled.description: When true, removes all default styling.

contentStyle.description: Inline styles applied to the tooltip content element.

arrowStyle.description: Inline styles applied to the tooltip arrow element.

baseArrowStyle.description: Inline styles applied to the base arrow element.
